name: Time picker
description: Scrollable columns of hours, minutes, and optional period (AM/PM) to pick a time, inline or in a popover (TimePickerTrigger). Quiet scrollbars with scroll-snap, touch target heights driven by density tokens, and high contrast support.

classes.ayy-time-picker: Root container: scrollable columns of hours, minutes, and optional period (AM/PM).
classes.ayy-time-picker__columns: Flex row of scrollable time columns with quiet borders.
classes.ayy-time-picker__col: Column with vertical scroll-snap and quiet scrollbars.
classes.ayy-time-picker__item: Selectable button option in a time column (hour, minute, period).
classes.ayy-time-picker__item--selected: The selected time item, styled with primary fill.
classes.ayy-time-picker-trigger: Field-like button trigger showing the formatted time and opening the popover.
classes.ayy-time-picker-trigger__value: Formatted time display inside the trigger, or placeholder when empty.

default.looks: A row of scrollable columns (hours, minutes, and optional AM/PM period) with muted, selectable numbers.

hover.looks: Wash-hover background on items, line-hover border on the trigger.

disabled.looks: Dimmed with disabled opacity and not-allowed cursor.

selected.looks: Primary background and contrast foreground text on the picked option.

error.looks: Destructive border on the trigger and destructive ring when focused.

loading.none: No loading look. If available times load asynchronously, display a Skeleton until ready.

empty.looks: Displays data-placeholder in muted text like an input.

sizes.density: Item cells and trigger height follow the md control height (32px compact, 40px comfortable, 44px touch).
sizes.width: Columns fit their content (hours, minutes, period) and scroll vertically; fits in a popover or inline.

js: timePickerClass({ className? }) → string; timePickerTriggerClass({ className? }) → string; connectTimePicker(root, { value?, format?, step?, onSelect? }) → { setValue, update, focus, destroy } draws and wires time columns on plain markup; generateHours(format?), generateMinutes(step?), parseTimeString(str), formatTime(hours, minutes, format?), formatTimeString(str, format?), to12Hour(h24), to24Hour(h12, period). timePickerClockIcon (SVG markup).

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-time-picker: draws the hour, minute and optional AM/PM period columns into it, scrolls to the selected options, and wires clicks and arrow keys. In an <ayy-popover> whose trigger holds an .ayy-time-picker-trigger__value, it writes the formatted time there.

attributes.value: The picked time ("09:30" or "02:30 PM"). Updated when a time is picked.
attributes.name: Form name: a hidden input inside carries the picked time.

events.ayy-select: { value } when a time is picked.

props.value / defaultValue: string — the picked time ("14:30" or "02:30 PM")
props.onValueChange: (time: string) => void — called when a time is selected
props.step: number — minute step between options (e.g. 5, 15). Default 5

TimePickerTrigger.renders: <button class="ayy-time-picker-trigger" aria-haspopup="dialog"> + <div class="ayy-popover" popover> with a TimePicker

props.value / defaultValue: string — the picked time ("14:30" or "02:30 PM")
props.onValueChange: (time: string) => void — called when a time is selected
props.placeholder: string — shown while empty. Default "Pick a time"
props.step: number — minute step between options. Default 5
props.name: string — a hidden input carries the time string

a11y: Columns use role="listbox" with aria-label for hours, minutes, and period; items use role="option" with aria-selected indicating the current selection.
Each selectable button has a visible :focus-visible focus ring and meets touch target sizing at touch density.
The popover trigger uses aria-haspopup="dialog" and connects with aria-controls to the popover.
Windows High Contrast (@media (forced-colors: active)) maps selected items to Highlight and HighlightText.
do: Use TimePickerTrigger in forms where selecting hours and minutes from discrete steps is preferred over typing.
Use step={15} or step={30} for scheduling apps (meetings, bookings) to keep the list short and fast to navigate.
Set format="12h" or format="24h" to match the user's locale and conventions.
dont: Don't use a time picker when native <Input type="time"> is sufficient for rapid keyboard entry.
Don't use step={1} for calendar scheduling where 15 or 30 minute increments are expected.
Don't close the popover after selecting only the hour; users need to pick both hour and minute.
